messages:
Maya (Marketing): Quick sync on social for the launch + webinar. Need schedule, assets, UTMs, and reply templates by EOD.

Ava (Social): Can do. Proposed times: X thread 2pm PT, LinkedIn 11am PT, reminder 24h before, and 1h before day-of. Will test staging post first.

Priya (Content): I'll prepare 2 X thread variants (short and narrative) and 1 LinkedIn carousel caption. Also a 30s speaking transcript.

Sam (Design): Specs: X image 1200x1200; LinkedIn 1200x627; carousel 1080x1080; hero clip 16:9 mp4 <50MB. Will produce hero + benchmark slide + 3 short graph clips.

Jon (Growth): Benchmarks to call out (conservative): ~40% cost reduction, ~85ms median latency @ 2k tokens on our test config. Add a footnote: "results vary by model/hardware."

Liam (Sales Ops): UTMs: utm_source=social, utm_medium={x|linkedin}, utm_campaign=launch_aug24. Route demo requests to HubSpot queue "Inbound - Social". Tag leads who click benchmark asset as "benchmark_interest".

Ava (Social): Engagement playbook: short templates for pricing, SLA, demo, methodology, RSVP, and negative feedback. Will post templates here.

Priya (Content): X thread draft (short):
- Tweet 1: Redwood Inference update: faster + cheaper LLM inference.
- Tweet 2: Join our webinar Thurs 9am PT for benchmarks + Q&A. RSVP: <link>?utm_campaign=launch_aug24
- Tweet 3: Snapshot: ~40% lower per-token cost; 85ms median latency @2k tokens.

Sam (Design): Uploading mock v1 to Drive now. Which CTA color?

Maya (Marketing): CTA color remains #0057FF. Use 16px rounded button.

SocialBot (scheduler): Staging posts queued for 2024-07-30T10:00:00-07:00. Will schedule main posts after assets confirmed.

Ava (Social): Quick reply templates:
1) Pricing: "Thanks — DMing pricing + link: <pricing_url>?utm_campaign=launch_aug24"
2) SLA/Dedicated: "Tagging @Liam — our sales ops will follow up."
3) Methodology: "Methodology link in thread; DM for raw data."
4) Demo: "Book a demo: <demo_link> — choose 'Inbound - Social'"
5) RSVP: "Thanks! Add to calendar: <ics_link>"
6) Feedback: "Appreciate it — could you DM specifics?"

Liam (Sales Ops): SDRs please record source_detail=organic|paid and benchmark_asset_clicked=true|false on lead records. SocialBot should POST form data to HubSpot.

Jon (Growth): If >50 signups first hour, bump paid spend and retarget commenters who clicked benchmark. Sam, slice assets for ads if needed.

Maya (Marketing): Final checklist:
- Priya: final copy + transcript (today)
- Sam: images + clips (EOD)
- Ava: schedule + templates (today)
- Jon: UTMs + landing mapping (today)
- Liam: HubSpot routing (today)

Priya (Content): Files uploaded to Drive: https://drive.company/redwood/launch-aug (placeholder).

Maya (Marketing): Thanks team ")
